components.Name: Catapult
components.rationale: Missing root README metadata; conservatively retain notice for generated/packaged tracing assets.

components.Name: Perfetto Android protobuf schemas
components.rationale: Schema source headers carry Apache-2.0; generated code may be linked.

components.Name: Perfetto Chromium protobuf schemas
components.rationale: Schema headers name Chromium BSD license.

components.Name: Rust GN wrappers
components.rationale: Aggregator/build glue; individual crates retain their own scanner metadata.

components.Name: Crubit
components.rationale: Retain notice conservatively for binding support; generator reachability alone does not prove runtime linkage.

components.Name: SwiftShader LLVM 10
components.rationale: LLVMJIT.cpp/LLVMContext.cpp use Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; upstream versioned root license recovered from llvmorg-10.0.0. Support subdirectory adds copyright; do not discard historical notices.

components.Name: SwiftShader Marl
components.rationale: Missing root README; linked by packaged libvk_swiftshader.

components.Name: Rust standard library and bundled library dependencies
components.License: See COPYRIGHT-library.html; includes MIT, Apache-2.0 and LLVM exceptions
components.rationale: Actual std rlib is a linker input. Preserve complete toolchain-supplied library copyright/licensing inventory rather than treating compiler license as sufficient.
